nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the contract owner, set in the Owned constructor from msg.sender
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer
IAMSMART.symbol token ticker, set to 'IMT' in constructor
IAMSMART.name token name, set to 'IAMSMART' in constructor
IAMSMART.decimals token decimals, set to 8 in constructor
IAMSMART._totalSupply total token supply minted to the deployer address
IAMSMART.balances mapping(address => uint) of token balances mutated by transfer/transferFrom
IAMSMART.allowed mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of ERC20 allowances
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): checked addition with require(c >= a)
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): checked subtraction with require(b <= a)
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): checked multiplication with require(a == 0 || c / a == b)
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): checked division with require(b > 0)
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender, unrestricted caller becomes owner
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner: stages a new owner address
acceptOwnership() public: requires msg.sender == newOwner, then replaces owner and zeroes newOwner
IAMSMART constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals and mints _totalSupply to a fixed address
totalSupply() constant returns uint: _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant returns balances[tokenOwner]
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): spends allowance and moves balances
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant returns the remaining allowance
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval(...)
Fallback function () public payable: immediately reverts, rejecting ETH
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: arbitrary external token transfer out
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances and allowance indexing
Arithmetic addition a + b with manual overflow check (pre-0.8 unchecked math)
Arithmetic subtraction a - b with manual underflow check (pre-0.8 unchecked math)
Arithmetic multiplication a * b with manual overflow check (pre-0.8 unchecked math)
Arithmetic division a / b with manual divide-by-zero check
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an attacker-controlled address
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary token contract
Ownership replacement sequence: emit OwnershipTransferred, owner = newOwner, newOwner = address(0)
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) authorization gate
Parameter to of IAMSMART.transfer, the receiver address
Parameter tokens of IAMSMART.transfer, the amount moved
Parameter from of IAMSMART.transferFrom, the debited account
Parameter to of IAMSMART.transferFrom, the credited account
Parameter tokens of IAMSMART.transferFrom, the amount moved
Parameter spender of IAMSMART.approve, the allowance grantee
Parameter tokens of IAMSMART.approve, the allowance amount
Parameter spender of IAMSMART.approveAndCall, both allowance grantee and the callee contract
Parameter tokens of IAMSMART.approveAndCall, the allowance amount forwarded to receiveApproval
Parameter data of IAMSMART.approveAndCall, attacker-controlled calldata forwarded to receiveApproval
Parameter tokenAddress of IAMSMART.transferAnyERC20Token, the arbitrary contract to call
Parameter tokens of IAMSMART.transferAnyERC20Token, the amount transferred out
Parameter _newOwner of Owned.transferOwnership, the staged successor owner
